The flower market is one of the best places in the city. Nina wrote about the day in the diary. Jack's birthday is in August. Also, the rice harvest starts next week.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the flower market by bike. Nina learned a lot about math. Both of them like salad and milk. The earth goes around the sun.
Last Friday, Nina and Jack went to the flower market. The weather was rainy that day. Life is full of small surprises. Heavy rains caused floods in the valley.
Nina thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. Nina is going to travel to Paris in August. Nina drinks milk after doing sports.
